segments.name: Consumer Banking and Lending
segments.description: Provides banking, lending and mortgage products and services to consumers.
segments.evidence: We provide a diversified set of banking, investment and mortgage products and services, as well as consumer and commercial finance, through our four reportable operating segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management.

segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Provides banking and commercial finance products and services to business customers.
segments.evidence: Our management reporting is organized into four reportable operating segments: Consumer Banking and Lending; Commercial Banking; Corporate and Investment Banking; and Wealth and Investment Management.

segments.name: Corporate and Investment Banking
segments.description: Provides investment banking and markets products and services to corporate and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: Our management reporting is organized into four reportable operating segments: Consumer Banking and Lending; Commercial Banking; Corporate and Investment Banking; and Wealth and Investment Management.

segments.name: Wealth and Investment Management
segments.description: Provides investment advisory and wealth management services to clients, with fees based on asset values.
segments.evidence: Fees from the majority of Wealth and Investment Management (WIM) advisory assets are based on a percentage of the market value of the assets at the beginning of the quarter.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Wells Fargo net interest income on loans plus noninterest fees including deposit-related fees, investment advisory and asset-based fees, card fees, mortgage banking and trading gains.
revenueModel.evidence: Investment advisory and other asset-based fees increased driven by higher asset-based fees reflecting higher market valuations .

changes.text: In 2025, Wells Fargo acquired its merchant services joint venture, with revenue thereafter included in card fees.
changes.evidence: Card fees increased driven by higher revenue following our merchant services joint venture acquisition in 2025, as well as increased consumer credit card activity.

changes.text: In 2025, Wells Fargo sold the non-agency portion of its commercial mortgage third-party servicing business.
changes.evidence: a $263 million gain on the sale of the non-agency portion of our commercial mortgage third-party servicing business in 2025
